messages:
alex: Quick sync — cross-repo PRs for today

PRs to coordinate: redwood-js-sdk #412, api-server #987, redwood-console #203, infra/helm #78. Target deploy window 17:30 PT. Any blockers?

maria: @alex API change is the blocker for SDK. SDK regenerates client types against the new contract. API PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api-server/pull/987

kevin: api-server #987 failing one integ test (auth header edge case). Repro: `npm run test:integration -- -t AuthHeaderSpec`. I can push a fix but need a quick review after CI.

sophia: console #203 depends on /v1/models shape change. Left a note about nullable fields, will push tiny console patch after api merge. infra/helm #78 needs image tag update to match runtime build.

maria: I can pair with @kevin at 15:00 PT to fix the integ test. If CI is green by 16:00, SDK can rebase and be ready for the window.

kevin: pairing SGTM. Will open fix commit in a few. @devops-bot can you reserve the 17:30 slot? :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Deploy window reserved for 17:30 PT. Suggested merge order: 1) api-server (#987) 2) runtime image build + infra/helm (#78) 3) redwood-console (#203) 4) redwood-js-sdk (#412). Will canary to staging first. :robot_face:

alex: Sounds good. Who will merge SDK? Prefer someone other than the author to check changelog & client bump.

maria: I can merge SDK #412 after API and console are green. Will rebase and run full e2e locally.

kevin: pushed fix `fix/auth-header-edgecase`, tests passing locally, requesting @sophia review on response shape. CI running.

sophia: small nit about null check, will approve after patch. :eyes:

sophia: Approved api-server #987. :white_check_mark:

maria: Rebased redwood-js-sdk #412 onto main and updated generated client. Local e2e passing. Planned merge command: `gh pr checkout 412 && gh pr merge 412 --squash --admin` (merge last).

alex: Plan: @kevin merge api-server now, @sophia merge console when CI green, @maria merge SDK last. @devops-bot start runtime build after api merge and post image tag here for infra helm update.

devops-bot: Runtime build started after api merge. Will post image tag when ready.

kevin: merged api-server #987. :shipit:

devops-bot: Runtime image built: `redwood/runtime:20260317-rc3`. infra/helm #78 updated values.yaml to that tag and lint fixed. Helm CI passing.

sophia: merged redwood-console #203. Verified staging canary, no UI regressions.

maria: merged redwood-js-sdk #412 and published npm `@redwood/sdk@1.14.0`. Notifying ops to promote to prod during window.

alex: Great work all. After deploy paste a short post-deploy check here (latency, error rate, smoke tests). If anything critical, we'll roll back runtime image. :thumbsup:
